cc3739e9f1b35b2aa47a1058.title: The fortress beneath Oakhurst
paragraphs: These passages were the company's first descent into the Sunless Citadel, where the search for the Hucreles became a struggle through rival factions and forgotten rooms. The long road to Ashardalon began inside this small, buried world.

a88998139fd818cc86fa12c9.title: Below the fortress, the roots
paragraphs: The lower caverns led towards Belak and the Gulthias Tree, where the mystery of the strange apples took root. What looked like a local harvest carried a danger that could spread far beyond Oakhurst.

5cbd2015b6d87ac4041d6ff1.title: The first way down
paragraphs: The broken ground above the Citadel marked the boundary between Oakhurst's missing adventurers and the darkness holding them. Beyond this descent waited giant rats, hidden ways, and the company's first lessons in surviving together.

f54c5527eed5f5f7867ad9fc.title: A whistle in an old tomb
paragraphs: The Night Caller belonged among the Citadel's older secrets, beneath the troubles of goblins, kobolds, and missing adventurers. This glimpse of its tomb recalls how much forgotten magic lay behind an apparently simple rescue.

445808b4e0960603c7db09f6.title: Small teeth, early troubles
paragraphs: Before ancient dragons and planar armies, the darkness had rats and other hungry things close to the floor. Shrop's introduction to the Citadel made such humble dangers quite memorable enough.

bfa409a7daff3dd4326ef1de.title: Calcryx in the buried fortress
paragraphs: Calcryx, the white dragon wyrmling, belonged to the rivalries inside the Sunless Citadel. Her image recalls a dungeon where a creature's size offered little assurance about the trouble it could cause.

9a0798780413a1a42cf103a1.title: Balsag and the rat hounds
paragraphs: Balsag and his hunting beasts embody the less welcoming inhabitants of the buried fortress. They belong to the early chapter when every new chamber could turn a search into a fight.

8927361bb871086a9443fc6a.title: The Twilight Grove
paragraphs: Here the Citadel's broken masonry gave way to the sinister life beneath it. Belak's work and the Gulthias Tree turned the rescue into a discovery the company had to carry back to Oakhurst.

12e9dc1dc2a4df46dc8642e2.title: The Dragon Priest's rest
paragraphs: The Dragon Priest's tomb preserves the fortress's older devotion to draconic power. It gives the first adventure another shadow of the dragon-haunted history that would follow Team Biscuit for years.

3fcb2c0a3cad25fb60b56635.title: The Stone Tooth
paragraphs: The map recovered from the Citadel led towards Durgeddin's lost stronghold beneath this landmark. Reaching the mountain meant exchanging Oakhurst's buried ruin for the orc-held approaches to Khundrukar.

8677666c925f5971613b1d14.title: The Glitterhame
paragraphs: These caverns opened beneath Khundrukar, where water and strange growth concealed the paths onward. The company's progress through them tied survival to questions of fungus, light, and what waited below the ruined hold.

6d2241a26174d593d115f644.title: A dragon beneath the mountain
paragraphs: This image gathers the Forge's descent into a single promise of danger below a crossing. For Team Biscuit, that promise eventually acquired a name: Nightscale, waiting in the Black Lake.

9ff996e2d35960e86e31c7c5.title: Durgeddin's mountain
paragraphs: The Stone Tooth rose above the chambers where Durgeddin's works had outlasted their maker. The company came seeking the lost forge, but first had to deal with those who had claimed its approaches.

f39f70a71d4e8d617de19863.title: Thunder's crossing
paragraphs: A narrow rope bridge offered a particularly honest introduction to Khundrukar's depths. Thunder went first, while the rest of the company had good reason to appreciate both his balance and his nerve.

1bb8525d962811b5d8c7186c.title: Growth in the Glitterhame
paragraphs: The caverns beneath the hold had become a world of fungus and unfamiliar light. What grew there could be an obstacle, a clue, or one more reason to watch where an adventurer put a hand.

c8ac931f9c9a6920745e05ac.title: Other smiths at the forge
paragraphs: The duergar had brought their own purpose to Durgeddin's ruined stronghold. Their presence made the lost forge a place of living interests and bargains as well as old dwarven history.

6e2b3c90f6129d43ffa4a579.title: The Foundry's remains
paragraphs: The ruined workrooms held the memory of Durgeddin's craft and the evidence of those using it after him. Terry's interest in the forge belonged to a journey where dwarven history was becoming something much more personal than a tale.

bfdfb58a4da1a9073563e1e0.title: Nightscale's water
paragraphs: The Black Lake concealed the dragon at the bottom of the company's descent. Nightscale made the final reaches of Khundrukar a place where the surface of the water could be as dangerous as a drawn blade.

48e9b1d14c75b001dcd5da84.title: The road between towns
paragraphs: The journey towards Brindinford linked the company to the wider country beyond its first dungeons. A town on a map would soon become a place of celebrations, conspiracies, and repeated returns.

edd50327d6e4addc9e636169.title: A little theatrical deduction
paragraphs: The campaign's comic detective face belongs beside Brindinford's accumulating clues and questionable explanations. Finding the next door was often easier than deciding whom to believe on the other side.

3650110dc9770508dec3d0b4.title: The detective takes a bow
paragraphs: Another pose for the campaign's purple-coated detective brings a little levity to the work of investigation. The joke sits comfortably beside a chapter where a street fair concealed a remarkably tangled conspiracy.

3ffe83f1c6e06a254c87ae78.title: A dwarf fit for the road
paragraphs: This armoured dwarven warrior evokes the stubborn strength Terry brought to the company's early travels. The forge beneath the Stone Tooth offered plenty of work for someone who trusted endurance, steel, and a practical answer.

b4f39b14480f9d7228b07ca6.title: Durnan's face
paragraphs: Durnan's portrait joins the wider company of innkeepers, travellers, and familiar faces surrounding the early adventures. It recalls the human scale of the road before the mysteries of Brindinford widened into the affairs of planes and gods.

a011e94063d27953a2a4dff7.title: An apple and an invitation
paragraphs: The little verse about the fruit of labour recalls the strange harvest behind the Citadel's mystery. Belak's apples could look like a blessing long before their roots revealed another purpose.

5d0bbe4f94b29c353f94486f.title: Shatterspike, remembered
paragraphs: Shrop brought Shatterspike out of the Sunless Citadel and carried it into the company's growing history. In Brindinford, the sword's final significance would lie in the sacrifice made at Pelor's temple.

8f6b2cd5cbe5d9830a1b4709.title: The crowded country around a dungeon
paragraphs: This small landscape of roads and buildings recalls the settlements waiting above the company's first underground battles. Returning from the Citadel meant bringing news to people whose lives continued beyond the dungeon walls.

63ab90e7a7ee65da7b598c20.title: Akrew's grin
paragraphs: Akrew belongs to the conspiracy behind Brindinford's public troubles and the Baron's compromised authority. His familiar goblin face made the Stolen Sons connection especially unwelcome to Shrop and his companions.

163739c0ca45d2643b34b0a2.title: A small scout in a large adventure
paragraphs: The weasel recalls the familiars and small scouts who could inspect a danger before the company committed itself. In places like Nightfang Spire, a glimpse through the next passage could be worth far more than another weapon.

3c44da05b81a4e8df69eaf40.title: A mark upon the Stone Tooth
paragraphs: The marked mountain map turns the legend of Khundrukar into a destination the company could actually approach. Beneath that landmark lay the orc defences, ruined chambers, and lost works of Durgeddin.

585da672fa60a5b83c22f62b.title: Following Khundrukar's passages
paragraphs: This plan gathers the routes and rooms of the mountain's upper defences into one view. It recalls how every crossing and unexplored door complicated the apparently straightforward task of finding a forge.

5897a1365e376e6427121ebd.title: A fortress imagined in stone
paragraphs: This fortress illustration offers a broader image of the craft and ambition behind a dwarven stronghold. It belongs beside the search for Durgeddin's legacy, when the company was learning what remained after a great hold fell.

b57a8fada4d6d0a86ce2d42b.title: A doorway with an old story
paragraphs: Roots and carved stone make this threshold an echo of the secrets beneath the Citadel. It recalls the way the company's early discoveries mixed ancient structures with a life that had grown dangerously through them.

ebce53de9a481357f6762460.title: The sign of the sun
paragraphs: Pelor's emblem places this small animation beside the struggle for his temple in Brindinford. A familiar holy sign became something the company had to defend when the town's supposed guardians turned against its priests.

f5a95d76bf0742cf0d3d5320.title: Strength carried on a belt
paragraphs: A giant's face upon a belt recalls the magical equipment that could turn a traveller into something formidable. Such treasures became part of the company's identity as the road led from lost forges towards much larger enemies.

d8d95dc4ad1ef311654eb699.title: The town before the mountain
paragraphs: Blasingdell was part of the approach to Khundrukar, a settlement standing between ordinary life and Durgeddin's monster-held ruin. Its streets recall the last familiar comforts before the company went beneath the Stone Tooth.

80ef816bd7d934a02cf2afa7.title: Brother Calbert
paragraphs: A priest's quiet figure belongs beside the threatened faith of Brindinford. The struggle around Pelor's temple gave holy people and ordinary townsfolk a place in a conflict the company could no longer treat as someone else's trouble.

8c7e614eee9973807be02257.title: A face carved in warning
paragraphs: The staring stone face gives Brindinford's hidden places the expression their mysteries deserved. Beyond the fair, the company was discovering that madness and manipulation had already found rooms of their own.

308464d8ea6b5790934c4075.title: A beguiling face
paragraphs: The succubus portrait recalls the charms and deceptions surrounding the Baron's court. In Brindinford, a pleasant face could offer far less reassurance than it appeared to promise.

6a8c45944b91655aa95351b2.title: Khundrukar, spread before them
paragraphs: This wider view of the hold places the forge, its approaches, and the water below within one ruined stronghold. It recalls how far the company had to descend before Durgeddin's story gave way to Nightscale's lair.

93f689726e512db35fe7dd6a.title: Brindinford before its fall
paragraphs: The manor, temple, bell tower, and crowded streets made Brindinford a town the company could come to know. Those same landmarks would give the sunken ruins their painful familiarity much later.

5467ff9563a1b0342ab1847f.title: The Reality Wrinkle
paragraphs: The old shop hid a passage into Brindinford's stranger troubles. Long after that first investigation, its surviving doorway would offer Team Biscuit a route out of the buried city and towards Windglum.

9a67a0902eacb392555b03e8.title: Above the streets, the bell tower
paragraphs: The bell tower rose above a town whose ordinary sounds were becoming part of an unsettling mystery. Its place in Brindinford would endure even after the streets below it had fallen into ruin.

9f054236bddc797cb5de5e39.title: The threads behind the fair
paragraphs: This web of connections gathers the threats hidden beneath Brindinford's unrest. It recalls an investigation in which rescuing one victim or questioning one suspect opened the way to a larger design.

e0c0c0a962f81e98ce2107c1.title: The manor on Silver Hill
paragraphs: The Baron's house stood at the centre of the authority being turned against Brindinford. Reaching its rooms brought the company closer to the will behind the public decrees and the town's growing fear.

b61e5b18cbd9e163d00e3d02.title: Pelor's temple in plan
paragraphs: The temple was a place of refuge before the conspiracy made its priests outlaws. These chambers frame the company's struggle to cleanse the holy place and restore the light it represented.

d4f5b5770141eef1dab49f9b.title: Ways through the market
paragraphs: Brindinford's alleys could carry a crowd, a rumour, or an attacker out of sight. The fair made the town lively, while its narrow passages helped conceal the forces trying to seize it.

1ddf1030949e0ece8514c13b.title: The long street
paragraphs: Shops, homes, and a crowded street give the town's public life a shape beyond its battles. Team Biscuit first knew Brindinford as a place of people and celebration, which made its later ruin matter.

9f39fc9526da4b41376f1494.title: The Halfling Faire
paragraphs: Music and crowds welcomed the company into Brindinford's annual fair. The sudden trouble that followed made this cheerful gathering the opening of a much darker adventure.

8e78f5fe6300bc2686c2915e.title: A place to stop
paragraphs: The timbered roadside building recalls the inns and stopping places that made the company's travels possible. A roof, a table, and a conversation often came just before the next difficult discovery.

54086cb0509dcaae649e989f.title: The tower's upper reaches
paragraphs: The bell tower's stacked floors made a familiar town landmark into a place that could conceal danger above the streets. It belongs beside the company’s search for what was unsettling Brindinford from within.

f0e900894556e11b671fc366.title: The Stony Gaze
paragraphs: The Stony Gaze belonged to the town the company learned during its first Brindinford adventure. Like the temple and manor, its familiar rooms would lend the later memories of that town a particular weight.

664dd6d9fd537757e4a21ebd.title: High Priest Forgrim
paragraphs: Forgrim's stern portrait stands beside the effort to defend Pelor's temple and its people. When the Baron's decrees outlawed the priests, the town's crisis reached directly into the refuge they offered.

257136cf04919ad9096ae2b7.title: Torea's concern
paragraphs: Torea's face recalls the aftermath of the rescue from Brindinford's cultists and the gathering at Pelor's temple. Gratitude and worry shared the room, because the rescued could not yet explain how the evil had reached them.

7183e17c55cf616e95660c82.title: Captain Aldrich
paragraphs: Aldrich belongs to the town guard caught inside Brindinford's collapse of trustworthy authority. His portrait sits beside the chapter in which protecting a town required looking beyond its official commands.

d49929ea4483b42056308cfe.title: The adventurers at the table
paragraphs: This glimpse of the tabletop recalls the company gathered inside Brindinford's rooms of hospitality and intrigue. A feast could celebrate a rescue while leaving the next plot close enough to hear the toast.

5e8473aeb1661dcbbb05c73c.title: A town beneath a hostile sky
paragraphs: The threatened streets in this illustration echo Brindinford's turn from celebration towards terror. The company had to discover whose purpose lay behind the fear before the town surrendered itself to a false remedy.

681d92215b8fd08955a38fb3.title: Thanks at Pelor's temple
paragraphs: Forgrim, Marith, Aldrich, and Torea gather around the rescued Alain as gratitude turns towards the question of what comes next. The temple scene leads into the Baron's summons, where reassurance would give way to a much harsher announcement.

5e669e708f391c5f9caba297.title: The bells call the town
paragraphs: The opening words and tolling summons frame Brindinford's slide into a deeper danger. The company had already helped its people, yet the town's next public gathering would carry the conspiracy further.

2b2b536d4b94ce97bbd41eb7.title: A gathering at the fountain
paragraphs: The figures around Brindinford's fountain preserve a moment of the town as the company encountered it at the table. Streets that could host a gathering could also become the ground on which its future was fought.

6c180e7ad3f055fc4a2c8e90.title: The Baron's proclamation
paragraphs: Euphemes closes the fair and the city gates, bans weapons, and turns Pelor's priests into outlaws. The filmed proclamation gives a voice to the point where Brindinford's own authority became part of its imprisonment.

a0aa1a120567e46403bc1aa1.title: A city under an unnatural sky
paragraphs: Lightning and a blade-bright omen turn this cityscape into a backdrop for the campaign's rising threats. It belongs beside Brindinford's crisis as an image of a town overshadowed by powers beyond its streets.

0d01d4de42b4abf89ddff040.title: Axiom's hidden will
paragraphs: The mind flayer Axiom stood behind the will being imposed upon the Baron. His portrait brings the town's scattered disturbances back to the creature whose control the company had to break.

0a5c463dcf5977efb8d8b0ae.title: Akrew's last welcome
paragraphs: Akrew greets Shrop and the company with the claim that the orders are already signed and the city belongs to the Stolen Sons. His little surprise summons old enemies into a confrontation the heroes could no longer avoid.

4727e2e0c906d842fdeeb00c.title: Another face of the mind flayer
paragraphs: The black-and-white portrait makes the alien intelligence behind Brindinford's troubles unmistakable. What began with public disorder ended in a fight against control that reached into another person's mind.

2d306c4e3636685a20667553.title: The company in the firelight
paragraphs: This fiery group image recalls the company growing into its own legend after the earliest dungeon expeditions. The adventures would change scale, but the same familiar faces kept arriving together at the next dangerous door.

a293eff02d896a38c2ba911e.title: The elemental bargain
paragraphs: The forest meeting and the guardian beyond it connect this film to the bargain surrounding Nightfang Spire. A route into the tower depended on more than breaking stone: the company had to deal with powers already keeping watch.

7f7d7d6be88116550d6ab86b.title: A feast with shadows around it
paragraphs: The laid table recalls the hospitality surrounding the company's rescue of Brindinford. Celebration did not make the town safe, and its honours could place the heroes within reach of another conspiracy.

a0ec971fbee5508a6d6592d1.title: Muscle at the wrong doorway
paragraphs: This scarred brute belongs to the threatening faces gathered around the campaign's early conflicts. He gives the Baron's chapter a fitting reminder that manipulation usually kept some very direct violence nearby.

e6040aa15774f15d17704419.title: Ossington within the stones
paragraphs: The village's houses and fields stood inside a double circle of ancient stones. Team Biscuit arrived to find a community whose welcome concealed a much less ordinary explanation for its troubles.

2a7f5ff60d6981055e4bd493.title: A cottage near the mystery
paragraphs: The homely buildings and cultivated ground belong beside the picture Ossington presented to its visitors. The company's danger grew from discovering how little that appearance could be trusted.

8af34633f00118f80995d1bd.title: Saithnar, remembered in stone
paragraphs: The ancient warrior's image recalls Saithnar and the conversation the company sought beneath Ossington's older history. Speaking with a dead warlord proved more useful than accepting every living explanation at face value.

9c130bff463d247dff018cb3.title: Ossington after dark
paragraphs: This shadowed view gives the village the unease hidden beneath its first welcome. Beyond the houses, old monuments and older purposes were waiting for the company to ask the right questions.

60bbe3ca7f1d5d2746e98dbc.title: Beneath Red Horse Hill
paragraphs: The hill's chambers carried the adventure below Ossington's apparently familiar countryside. What lay beneath helped connect the village's present deception to a much older story.

8e1d56a81bcb147f018fa4d4.title: The Silence Keepers' stones
paragraphs: The isolated circle recalls the ancient boundaries and duties surrounding Ossington. The company's discoveries would reveal that the stones mattered for reasons far older than the village's immediate fears.

a2c69679c986c5c4954004f2.title: Reaver's Spike
paragraphs: The blade and its bleak resting place evoke the warlike history beneath Ossington's mystery. It belongs beside Saithnar's chapter, where old weapons and old loyalties still cast long shadows over the living.

afcb3899fe277728a22e2095.title: A landscape of uneasy paths
paragraphs: The broken approaches, water, and wooded ground recall the country in which the company's investigation became an ambush. Getting out of danger could require a sudden change of shape rather than another exchange of blows.

2acc421133e950930af6c5af.title: The island in the tarn
paragraphs: The island and its crossing place the adventure's questions within the lonely waters around Ossington. The Horseman's answers belonged to a landscape where the dead could know more than the village would admit.

1995eec8c922a197415127f9.title: Fire over Ossington's chapter
paragraphs: The burning dragon image gives this stretch of the journey its proper sense of calamity. The company’s actual escape from ambush and a burning tower had already supplied enough danger without a quiet road home.

21537f6fbd24bc81ba381512.title: The shape of Nightfang Spire
paragraphs: The circular tower rose as a sealed promise of secrets above its buried chambers. Entering Nightfang meant finding a way through a structure built to hold its dead history close.

6301ab2a9274149dea0d5169.title: The tower's first floor
paragraphs: The first level gives shape to the chambers the company had to reach beyond Nightfang's exterior. It marks the beginning of a climb and descent through traps, undead, and the legacy of Gulthias.

f6e8bd9fd6ed2a319ac30675.title: Nightfang, level by level
paragraphs: These rooms show the tower extending beyond its first guarded threshold. Grim's discoveries and the company's caution had to keep pace with a building that could punish a missed detail very severely.

203f2c6cac13bbea6ebe071f.title: Another ring of chambers
paragraphs: The tower's repeating curves made each floor familiar in outline without making it safe. Every new set of doors could conceal a different answer to what Gulthias had gathered within Nightfang.

ee820553d705eb42eb7c63c0.title: The heat inside the tower
paragraphs: The fires and enclosed rooms of this level belong to the machinery of Nightfang's defences. The company was working through a structure whose old purpose had been turned towards the vampire's return.

8d84cada7d620030acb7fce2.title: Below the tower's crown
paragraphs: The upper chambers brought the company closer to the source of Nightfang's undead devotion. The ruined temple was preserving a cult as well as a vampire, with Ashardalon's name still hanging over both.

3f31a3634842eb857ea3c944.title: Nightfang's core
paragraphs: At the tower's heart, the circles and chambers drew the company's descent towards Gulthias. Defeating the vampire would expose another part of the long history surrounding Ashardalon's ruined heart.

260d380140411027b924f0d7.title: Thunder's other shape
paragraphs: The wererat image recalls the secret Thunder had entrusted to his companions after their earliest expedition. His extraordinary scouting travelled beside a danger of his own, long before Dydd's blood became the centre of the hunt.

a26399a2aea1236d4090cf79.title: Four figures in the hall
paragraphs: The company stands together in a grand stone interior, already recognisable as the companions who would carry the campaign. The monsters in the distance matter less here than the familiar arrangement of four adventurers facing them.

204116b0c05cac1cab27fa90.title: A closer plan of the first level
paragraphs: The numbered rooms make Nightfang's lower tower a maze of doors rather than a single imposing silhouette. Grim's eye for hidden ways mattered in precisely such places, where the next discovery could also be the next fall.

516c032e843286e221226330.title: The mohrg
paragraphs: The mohrg belongs to the restless dead serving Gulthias beneath Nightfang Spire. Its skeletal shape recalls how thoroughly the tower had exchanged a living temple's purpose for undeath.

b17de4f725a71b9da99d42c9.title: A guardian made of grave-stone
paragraphs: The tombstone golem gives Nightfang's funerary architecture a body capable of striking back. It fits a tower where even the memorials could seem unwilling to let the dead rest quietly.

91d121340edafedc99e20c4e.title: Grim brings his own light
paragraphs: Fire in one hand and cold magic in the other make this an image of Grim's growing command of the arcane. The curious gnome found plenty within Nightfang to test both his scholarship and his capacity for destructive answers.

681aeae5d8ce040963eb9ded.title: The earth answers
paragraphs: The earth elemental recalls the powers tied to the company's route into Nightfang. The tower's guardians were part of a world with interests of its own, and a bargain could open what weapons alone would not.

b5937ff7aff37a71f3553962.title: A face among the wights
paragraphs: The wight's portrait belongs to the undead company gathered around Gulthias's return. Nightfang's corridors turned the old cult's dead into active obstacles between Team Biscuit and the vampire.

71367dc36becda40375be9f2.title: A warrior out of the older tale
paragraphs: The armoured figure echoes the warlords and restless histories the company encountered around Ossington. Saithnar's chapter had shown that an ancient warrior could be a source of answers as well as a threat.

e33d8b3866f589b234156f09.title: The mooncalf above the Spire
paragraphs: The mooncalf gave Nightfang a horror large enough to invite Shrop's particular approach to a problem. His berserker's leap made the creature part of the company's story rather than merely an ominous shape against the moon.

a2da8036651b2296481da3b5.title: The room of Stitches
paragraphs: The chamber's table, tools, and scattered contents give Stitches a setting as disturbing as the creature itself. Within Gulthias's domain, flesh could become another material for making servants.

45604e43dc012de4d9703496.title: Blood upon the wood
paragraphs: The blood-marked warrior image belongs beside the cursed axe and Shrop's dangerous appetite for direct solutions. Nightfang offered more than enemies to strike: some of its dangers could come along in a companion's hands.

5578433578ca585f7ac06e4d.title: Pale Piercer
paragraphs: The blade's narrow, pale edge recalls the magic weapons gathered as the company ventured deeper into the campaign. In Nightfang's darkness, an acquired treasure could become part of the companions' continuing armoury long after its first discovery.

9bce1504c06b7b9aa1e7c216.title: Stitches
paragraphs: The assembled horror called Stitches belonged to the monsters the company overcame in Nightfang's undead world. Its portrait makes the tower's corruption visible in flesh rather than stone.

88b5b9c29a3eb8a61979b95e.title: Rhunad in the tower
paragraphs: Rhunad's familiar winged shape belongs among Nightfang's recurring foes and servants. The company’s path through the tower brought named enemies into a conflict already larger than a single vampire's lair.

a72f9f08e06d4934a6ae0004.title: Too many eyes in the dark
paragraphs: This many-eyed horror evokes the things that made a glance through Nightfang's doors an uncertain privilege. It belongs beside the company's work of scouting, searching, and deciding which discoveries were worth approaching.

70afa7793e848c2e7d05f7fe.title: Thiff the Smart
paragraphs: Thiff led girallons resisting Gulthias's rule beneath Nightfang, where servitude had divided the creatures living in the catacombs. His presence gives the tower's inhabitants motives beyond guarding the next room for a vampire.

3ea5df7b5dd87aeae1b4401d.title: The girallon alpha
paragraphs: The four-armed girallon recalls the powerful creatures Gulthias conditioned into servitors. Beneath the Spire, their strength and the rebellion around Thiff made the catacombs a contested place rather than an empty tomb.

3da191f5932b1f078ae86d0c.title: The treasure bites back
paragraphs: The mimic recalls an excellent reason the company could not greet every chest with unguarded delight. The Forge's hazards included furniture willing to make the first move.

5fc05cf4807cb7b9162f187c.title: A fortress below the surface
paragraphs: This subterranean stronghold gives the Underdark conflict a setting of guarded passages and defended chambers. Team Biscuit's descent had led into a struggle between peoples and powers already fighting for the deep places.

faee4a83293e6912840d45ff.title: The shrine above the magma
paragraphs: Vesperian's shrine belongs to the desmodus world the company discovered beneath the surface. Its linked chambers place Helkitrin's people and their records within a society with a history worth defending.

2ded77a5be2354b19bb575ab.title: Fire under Vesperian's shrine
paragraphs: The magma chamber reveals how close the deep settlements stood to the forces moving beneath them. The company's underground journey made fire a feature of the landscape as well as a weapon in enemy hands.

0220b6c580d84d6d2e23517e.title: One of the desmodus
paragraphs: The batlike desmodus were a people with homes, records, and enemies of their own. Meeting them turned the company's descent into an encounter with a threatened community rather than merely another monster-filled cave.

81ba4717e6ecc67397034f3b.title: Light beneath the earth
paragraphs: The illuminated cavern evokes the strange beauty surrounding the desmodus enclave. Deep Horizon gave the company a world that could be wondrous and imperilled at the same time.

04264cc2a4c11cc708c882f4.title: A warbat of the deep
paragraphs: The warbat's armoured shape belongs beside the fighting around the enclave. In the Underdark, the creatures above a battlefield could be every bit as dangerous as those holding its passages.

20bb9ec3438ed11a8fe8c416.title: A desmodu defender
paragraphs: The raised weapon gives the desmodus a martial face as well as a scholarly one. The company arrived amid a conflict in which the enclave's people were already struggling to keep their own home.

c248263e801ba8e95dfa248b.title: A weapon from an unfamiliar people
paragraphs: This curved weapon recalls the distinct craft and fighting traditions of the deep communities. The descent introduced Team Biscuit to equipment and customs that did not come from the familiar towns above.

4e03dbeaa0b6c72b2a16532f.title: A pause by the water
paragraphs: The turning water offers a small breathing space beside the dangers of the underground journey. The company's travels had room for such quiet moments even when the next passage led back towards conflict.

70b576aaf3de932adbb7d801.title: The branches of an underground journey
paragraphs: This gathering of places shows the deep adventure as a web of caverns, settlements, and guarded approaches. Each new location broadened the company's understanding of a realm that had first seemed hidden beyond the ordinary map.

f3eab28be8f657193e06da4c.title: A vrock in the deep
paragraphs: The vrock's wings and hooked face belong to the fiendish dangers surrounding the underground fighting. The company was learning that descending beneath the surface could also bring it closer to powers from much farther away.

8c9ea1a5204750b06a91c655.title: A settlement in the cavern
paragraphs: The cave-bound buildings make the Underdark a place where people live rather than merely a route through darkness. The company's discoveries carried the responsibility of recognising whose home was at stake.

dd23c6d51e7ce9cdb9cb73ba.title: The desmodus, armed and named
paragraphs: This fuller depiction gives the batlike people a presence beyond a distant silhouette. Their history and struggle became part of Team Biscuit's journey through the threatened enclave.

87b1e71336f3a50ff4d23e86.title: Helkitrin
paragraphs: Helkitrin offered records that connected the deep people's present troubles with the company's widening questions. An answer kept beneath the earth could still illuminate events far above it.

41e053f0f6b0f4711c02bd26.title: The salamanders' upper stronghold
paragraphs: The lava-lit chambers place the salamanders' ambitions within a fortress built for creatures of fire. The company's underground expedition had entered a war whose enemies were organised enough to hold a citadel.

a65886559ca6bb0475cdb657.title: Below the salamander citadel
paragraphs: The lower passages carried the salamanders' defences deeper around the molten ground. They recall the scale of a conflict that could not be understood from the first cavern alone.

0066bbb628017a2be9620bc8.title: The great tree and the lost elves
paragraphs: The tree-centred settlement recalls the elven history carried forward from Ossington. Below the surface, the company's earlier questions about those people found another landscape in which to continue.

18337dfe4336b24d7e86e279.title: The citadel's lower reaches
paragraphs: This closer view returns to the salamanders' chambers beneath the main stronghold. It places one part of the company's deep journey within the larger fight threatening the enclave.

2c556d3b353ff8194485c4a4.title: The heart of the fire stronghold
paragraphs: The citadel's main chambers show the defended ground behind the salamanders' pressure. Reaching such places meant following the conflict beyond rumours and into the homes of its aggressors.

30aa5bbcda0cc0d506ea246c.title: Circles beneath the canopy
paragraphs: The green rings recall the settlements tied to the adventure's elven connections. The company’s path below ground kept revealing that Ossington's story had not ended when it left the village.

4d556f96ff8a06bea3f1df44.title: Another elven circle
paragraphs: These smaller green enclosures give the lost communities another face in the deep adventure's landscape. Their place in the collection recalls the histories behind peoples the company first met as enemies or mysteries.

8b45e5cf13ee30b79d1c709f.title: The temple dungeon
paragraphs: The dark temple chambers belong beside the campaign's descent into old sanctuaries and their changed inhabitants. The company’s unfinished business from Ossington followed it into such places beneath the earth.

d74b25c457b1f04e7c628e1e.title: The narrower way below
paragraphs: The stone passage strips the Underdark down to its simplest demand: keep moving into the unknown. Beyond corridors like this, Team Biscuit found whole communities where it might once have expected only monsters.

e8a0ac87a79eb115fc844be2.title: The enclave's approach
paragraphs: The entrance's narrow, fiery course gives the enclave's danger a physical shape. The company's arrival placed it close to an attack already unfolding, where finding the way in was not the same as finding safety.

51b3bc1686996ae4a0e1e18f.title: An underground village
paragraphs: The clustered homes and strange growth show a lived-in world beyond sunlight. Such places gave the company a reason to care which side survived the deep conflict.

39ea71705249947c3c8572e5.title: Walls on the road to a greater fortress
paragraphs: This defended courtyard evokes the strongholds surrounding the campaign's widening military struggles. It belongs beside the journey from Rigus towards a fortress whose ambitions reached far beyond its own walls.

0ecc7d41f22e476bed29abe1.title: The next enclosure
paragraphs: Another stretch of walls and gates recalls the work of crossing defended ground one section at a time. The Iron Fortress chapter made every guarded approach part of a larger contest over power and the imprisoned smiths.

22590c51b64df2962bb2855f.title: Within the stone defences
paragraphs: The enclosed rooms suggest the ordinary machinery of a stronghold: routes, shelter, and the control of movement. Team Biscuit's planar expedition turned such military spaces into obstacles between it and Imperagon's purpose.

209260823637357f02c48d91.title: Kolyoral in the void
paragraphs: The immense cube hung in Acheron, a battlefield made into a world of its own. The company's journey beyond Rigus carried it into a plane where even the ground could move like a weapon.

ae9a7036d4f5fd6716b1b9da.title: Across the cube's faces
paragraphs: The spread of Kolyoral's surfaces makes its impossible geography visible. Reaching the Iron Fortress meant learning to think beyond the familiar arrangement of a road beneath a single sky.

90851340bc5a28b136577ccd.title: Zandikar, ground level
paragraphs: The rooms of Zandikar give substance to the stronghold that became Terry's. The forge, armour, and golem connections made ownership part of the story rather than simply another treasure added to the packs.

384ad499b9ac76d82ab29487.title: Zandikar, upper level
paragraphs: The upper chambers extend the view of Terry's fortress beyond its first doors. Zandikar became a lasting stake in a campaign whose travellers were usually passing through someone else's ruins.

ddaf8ef51207938df3caced6.title: Packleader Tavarus
paragraphs: Tavarus brought an organised hunter's presence to the dangers around the fortress expedition. His portrait recalls that the company faced leaders and loyalties within the enemy ranks, not merely a line of nameless guards.

01e75d5444047b85731b35f3.title: Pitboss
paragraphs: Pitboss's weathered face belongs to the company of contacts surrounding the Rigus and Acheron journey. Against that crowded backdrop, finding a way onward could depend as much on a conversation as on a gate.

6ab322b6bd80066ebc4b5278.title: The lion gate
paragraphs: The glowing circular gateway marked a passage beyond Rigus and the familiar world. Crossing it brought the company onto the road to Acheron and Imperagon's fortress.

6041f61c931033a9025e1c90.title: The behir's coils
paragraphs: The behir's long, powerful body evokes the living dangers around the fortress's approaches. The company's progress demanded room for creatures that could make even a broad passage feel very narrow.

f17c4a6f9a8b506bc4cff390.title: Thomas among the faces of the road
paragraphs: Thomas's portrait recalls the people surrounding the journey into the fortress's wider world. A campaign could turn on such meetings before anyone drew a sword or stepped through a planar gate.

ef4d522a7c3bf30af0eeba73.title: The Stagger Inn
paragraphs: The inn's lamps and tables belong to the pauses between the campaign's more dangerous crossings. In the Rigus chapter, a room where people could talk mattered to a party trying to understand what waited beyond the next gate.

41ab16827334089424c6d24b.title: Varachus
paragraphs: Varachus's infernal appearance set a fitting tone for the company’s dealings around Acheron. The road towards Imperagon passed through a world where useful information could arrive in thoroughly unsettling company.

af48327e602ab4dbd398aa3c.title: Varachus's mission
paragraphs: Varachus's filmed address belongs beside the search for the scattered weapon and the smiths' imprisoned souls. It carries the fortress chapter's stakes into a direct encounter with one of the figures surrounding that undertaking.

b9a9c380acaa4e7e99c737a6.title: The bloodstained guild notebook
paragraphs: The stained pages recall the Guild of Sleep investigation already under way around the fortress expedition. Information about dreams, missing people, and the soul crisis was arriving at a cost the company could see on the paper.

24c4a0cd9f955ed86a52a26b.title: A vessel for stranger seas
paragraphs: This unusual craft evokes travel in a campaign that eventually outgrew ordinary roads and waters. The passage from Angajuk's realm towards Acheron would make unfamiliar journeys a necessity rather than a curiosity.

17713a6c3ffd55da811e8000.title: A formian warrior
paragraphs: The formian gives the fortress's living guards a disciplined, insectile face. Team Biscuit's passage through Acheron brought it against communities organised around very different instincts from those of the towns it knew.

094c6a0901a563c02656f88f.title: The formian queen
paragraphs: The queen's towering shape recalls the hierarchy behind the formian defenders. The company was confronting an ordered society as well as the immediate danger of individual warriors.

ca7443fa2a3c2c22bebfd40f.title: The formian myrmarch
paragraphs: The myrmarch belongs among the powerful figures directing the formian ranks. Its image fits the fortress chapter's encounters with enemies who could coordinate, command, and hold defended ground.

b1627245d64cfcd10c7b01c5.title: An archon's trumpet
paragraphs: The trumpet archon brings a celestial presence to a chapter crowded with planar beings. The company’s dealings beyond Rigus showed that the interests of other worlds were never confined to a single kind of creature.

ed27e0216253f4d607ceada3.title: Too many heads
paragraphs: The hydra offers an image of brute danger beside the expedition's guarded approaches. It recalls the sort of problem for which one well-placed blow might still leave several other arguments unfinished.

255b48b8180b3ee3e4f04314.title: Comfort on an enormous scale
paragraphs: The richly dressed giant evokes the appetite, wealth, and theatrical power of the campaign's stranger courts. Such a face belongs beside the company's passage through places where a useful audience could be as daunting as a battle.

b775ac65d741c519e4791ffc.title: A fiend in the wider war
paragraphs: The horned fiend gives a face to the infernal interests gathering around the campaign's great weapons and imprisoned spirits. The company’s struggle with Imperagon was part of a world in which conquest attracted more than mortal ambition.

aa690e839fed796445368b23.title: Brindinford on another map
paragraphs: The town map brings the fortress expedition back to the people and places the company had left behind. While Team Biscuit crossed planes, Brindinford continued to have streets worth defending and enemies willing to enter them.

ae99cb0884cc9d9fa247ce5a.title: Rigus at the edge of Acheron
paragraphs: Rigus was the gateway town through which the company's road reached the plane of war. Its crowded rings would later carry another weight in the story, after the fall, the refugees, and the Red Keep's resistance.

84e99e6738e0313eae1f8595.title: The older art of dungeon danger
paragraphs: These stark dungeon scenes echo the traps, waiting creatures, and narrow escapes that accompanied the company's descent into stronger enemies' homes. They sit beside the fortress chapter as a reminder that grand ambitions still had to survive the next room.

e881fea561117e0362ab7c8c.title: A watcher at the threshold
paragraphs: The dark figure among stone and treasure evokes the hidden interests surrounding the hunt for Dydd's descendant. The party's road to Ashardalon was watched by powers that could see opportunity wherever the company saw danger.

fc81e20af5d1fc474d7995e8.title: An elder's familiar face
paragraphs: The elder gnome portrait belongs beside Grim's tangled family history and the story of Eudostis. The Sleeper's answers would turn a familiar face into part of the explanation for the Time Stone and a very long captivity.

ab10bdd3a0fb849d7cad7840.title: An anchor for the journey
paragraphs: The anchor belongs to the seafaring images surrounding Captain Pepper and the Deliverance. In this campaign, taking passage could mean trusting a crew whose voyage did not obey the boundaries of ordinary water.

d62bbd751ebaab8287fd65ad.title: The Deliverance beneath the waves
paragraphs: The ship's name returns the collection to the vessel that carried more than ordinary passengers. Captain Pepper and Xanthar's business would later bring the Deliverance alongside a falling boat at a particularly necessary moment.

989e61047322f4997a0932bf.title: Brother Xanthar's familiar face
paragraphs: The familiar face of Brother Xanthar concealed an intelligence the company had encountered beneath the water. Hindsight: he used Grim’s lost and forgotten book on making flesh golems to manufacture this body.
A K-vial later left him convinced he was Keraptis. His power and constructed form spared him the zombie fate; after defeating the reigning K-clone prime, he took White Plume Mountain.

56a90f5b423ae628007fc8eb.title: Keraptis leaves his mark
paragraphs: The eight-armed emblem stood behind the invitation to White Plume Mountain. After dreams and displaced years, the company had found another powerful figure willing to turn its journey towards a purpose of his own.
Hindsight: Xanthar would claim that name after a K-vial infection, defeat the reigning K-clone prime and rule the mountain himself. His certainty does not make him the original wizard.

4312af925c6cec0142cde947.title: Wave
paragraphs: The oceanic trident was one of the legendary weapons named in Keraptis's challenge. Its story would continue into the northern pursuit and the scheme surrounding the Candle of the Dark One.

Hindsight: Wave now rests with Whelm and Frostrazor back in White Plume Mountain through Xanthar’s theft. The surviving weapons remember Blackrazor as their sacrificed sibling and will never forgive the Brotherhood.

960f3cc750e2a28eff2f6ec3.title: Easthaven in the long winter
paragraphs: Snow, frozen water, and lit windows give the northern journey its everyday stakes. Team Biscuit entered a region where warmth and a meal could matter before any ancient magic revealed itself.

2f0b37683fe5db80602205d8.title: The execution square
paragraphs: Easthaven's public square placed the town's life and punishment in the same cold space. It belongs beside the northern chapter's encounters with local people, frightened communities, and the consequences of dangerous magic.

c0f81947bc84bb9cf3238e13.title: The White Lady Inn
paragraphs: The inn offered a recognisable doorway amid Easthaven's snow and haunted stories. Its image recalls the fragile comforts through which the company learned what the people of the Dale were enduring.

900fa846ba001c10683d2d10.title: A northern tavern's welcome
paragraphs: The Northlook illustration gives the northern journey another refuge of timber, lamps, and gathered travellers. Such places could turn a brief rest into a meal, a rumour, or the beginning of another expedition.

f5b9667224f79addd6c2e7c5.title: Dzaan at the stake
paragraphs: The burning wizard image recalls the Arcane Brotherhood's dangerous place in the northern adventure. The company's road would lead beyond public punishment to the Lost Spire and Vellynne's corrupted company.

11148c07fa6aaf5db6a638ed.title: The little shape of Pengu
paragraphs: Green eyes and an innocent outline make Pengu’s appearance especially treacherous. Behind that small shape was the spirit Shrop had released from the Nightmare Grotto’s candle, whose freedom brought the loss of magic and the company’s northern reckoning. Terry’s fourfold attunement and the sacrifice of Blackrazor brought the ritual to completion before the company emerged from Frostblight’s ruin.

3d123f9ed11e32061659746b.title: Pengu becomes something worse
paragraphs: The monstrous transformation reveals the power behind the spirit released from the grotto’s candle. Pengu’s corruption and anti-magic waves made the struggle reach far beyond a single body, until Frostblight’s fall allowed magic to begin its slow recovery. Terry’s fourfold attunement and the sacrifice of Blackrazor brought the ritual to completion before the company emerged from Frostblight’s ruin.

8840d1592c665ab405bde5c9.title: Pengu among the followers
paragraphs: Frostblight’s enormous penguin monument stood above the power that had drained magic from the world. Its shattering crowned the company’s escape after the completed ritual, Blackrazor’s sacrifice and Pengu’s transformation into the pulsing obsidian egg.

33ea4e67202d93232369bb38.title: The Dreamkeepers
paragraphs: The mutated followers give Pengu's influence a human face. They place the threat beyond one creature's strange body and among the people caught in its spreading power.

a97a34fae271ff6c94762fa5.title: The herd moves on
paragraphs: The departing penguins and scarred northern ground give the confrontation an aftermath larger than a single fallen enemy. The egg left behind meant the company could not treat that departure as proof that Pengu was gone for good.

e303b74915996ae69b23a8c0.title: Pengu speaks from the ice
paragraphs: The enthroned penguin gives the northern enemy a voice and a setting of its own. The company’s encounter with Pengu belonged to a campaign where even the strangest figure could carry a very serious appetite for power.

ef7b08301b1d7a766c75c9b2.title: An offer from Pengu
paragraphs: Pengu's address invites the mortals to kneel while treating their world as a source of power for a greater return. The film gives the confrontation a measure of the ambition behind the creature's uncanny appearance.

4e4b34aca337efd61d22d803.title: Kaelith, the Forsaken Queen
paragraphs: Kaelith's frozen, distorted regality belongs beside Pengu's transformed following. Her image carries the northern corruption into a courtly shape, where a title and a crown offered no protection from what the cold had made.

2cc3c3e5879f333a0d5169bb.title: The fungal dark
paragraphs: The luminous growth leads into the grotto explored by Brunn, Rook, Nox, and Elira. Beneath that strange beauty lay a planar wound whose escape route would eventually join Team Gravy to Team Biscuit in sunken Brindinford.

5fcbd73c6cb3377179e0cfb4.title: The Stony Gaze returns
paragraphs: The familiar inn plan draws the later collection back to Brindinford in the company's earlier lives. During the Sleeper's detour, a known town became the setting for adventurers suddenly playing the past again.

de3ec6ccb9e8d06646b28e94.title: A monster's beginning
paragraphs: The tiny dragon image sets an unsettling contrast beside Ashardalon's ancient hunger. The Bastion's final stakes concern lives before their beginning, while the creature consuming them has spent centuries refusing his own end.

905aae4f286595b0526dd6a9.title: The roads the party was following
paragraphs: The spread of places and faces reflects the many questions around the interrupted Bastion investigation. Thunder's blood, the soul crisis, and the hidden purposes of other powers had made the company’s search branch in several directions.

02ebf010ea0979c136f35f35.title: A vision with an enormous audience
paragraphs: The monstrous presence above the company evokes the way dreams made a room open onto a much larger danger. The Sleeper's answers would connect the travellers' immediate troubles to powers well beyond the world around them.

6d71257bc2e4d930bf393ecc.title: The Den of Ruin
paragraphs: The lonely refuge in this plan belongs beside the hidden approaches and secret watchers of the Bastion mystery. The company’s pursuit of answers was taking place in a world where powerful enemies also needed places to wait and listen.

81cfc903a5a4c3dd179150c5.title: A circle around an ancient tree
paragraphs: The great tree and its surrounding buildings recall the Church of the Elements and the First Tree investigation. The company had already begun following the history of Dydd before the long detours carried it away from Bastion's central question.

b7c32d4ff0e730902b3b2756.title: A vessel beyond ordinary roads
paragraphs: The overhead view of an unusual craft evokes travel between places that could no longer be joined by a horse and a road. The campaign's move towards Acheron made unfamiliar transport part of the company’s widening world.

9056c44dab81cc8dd7436e69.title: The passage grows darker
paragraphs: The narrow, broken stone approach offers an image of the pressure awaiting travellers inside a defended ruin. It belongs beside the fortress expedition's work of making progress through places built to resist it.

1415547ad637ec143911eb51.title: Answers among the roots
paragraphs: The old illustration of figures gathered beneath great roots recalls the druidical knowledge behind the First Tree. The company’s search for the soul crisis led through histories older than the organisations trying to explain it.

1f5930d3dbbb2e9b789780c1.title: Questions of life and death
paragraphs: The branching paths in this plan echo the campaign’s great uncertainty about souls and what becomes of them. The company would eventually carry those questions into the very place where lives were meant to begin.

e64872b471c45594fd3d4b6b.title: Ashardalon at the centre of the web
paragraphs: The connections gathered around the dragon show how the campaign's separate investigations began to converge. Dydd, the competing demonic minds, and the unborn souls would all give the same final destination a different significance.

6b5d51233e51108435bcbab5.title: A courtyard in the town's defence
paragraphs: The guarded town buildings recall Brindinford's military and civic life while the company travelled elsewhere. The people at home were living through threats that would later catch up with the adventurers themselves.

0f2c3c633d1066d39d91f80d.title: The roads behind the walls
paragraphs: Gates, streets, and enclosed buildings place the home front within reach of attack. They belong beside the chapter in which Brindinford remained part of the company's responsibilities despite the distance between worlds.

a308cf44333e421a57ee6d13.title: Ships at the water's edge
paragraphs: The harbour view brings the campaign back to voyages, crews, and uncertain passage. The Deliverance would make maritime travel part of a story that eventually passed through waterfalls and under the earth.

f8ec237b53624eb6546a7826.title: Fire through the mountain
paragraphs: The molten routes and massive wheels give the fortress journey a landscape of heat and machinery. The company was pursuing a weapon whose making depended on the exploitation of both a forge and the spirits forced to serve it.

d63e15ee7a99bf2ca578ee8d.title: Brindinford under threat
paragraphs: The burning settlement and its gathered defenders give the company's home front an immediate face. The planar expedition did not stop the war from reaching places where the adventurers had once been welcomed as rescuers.

cbee2138a5f9e7e3cbea4dd5.title: A serpent among the hidden powers
paragraphs: The black-and-white figure evokes the inhuman interests concealed behind the company’s hunt for answers. The Cathezar's pursuit showed how easily a traveller's ancestry could become someone else's valuable instrument.

2b936ebb147e0a23ede032ee.title: A small token with a darker promise
paragraphs: The red pendant recalls the campaign's habit of placing great significance in things small enough to wear. Marks, blood, and hidden allegiances mattered deeply in a hunt directed towards one living descendant of Dydd.

117b3f59951c5e3e0d1982ba.title: Nurn's borrowed face
paragraphs: Behind Nurn's human guise was a slaad serving Hethradiah, the rival mind within Demogorgon. His interest in the company belonged to the same struggle over Dydd's descendant that had sent the Cathezar after Thunder.

534b1a3debbfd011bd79aa03.title: A prisoner and the cost of the war
paragraphs: The chained captive evokes the cells and suffering behind the Red Keep's resistance. The company’s return to that wider war brought it back to people who had endured its consequences while the adventurers were elsewhere.

13b26e39d350650727fa1e72.title: Shoomma's smithy
paragraphs: The workrooms bring the company's investment with Shoomma and Horken into a tangible place of tools and craft. When time itself had become uncertain, the smithy offered one way to put treasure towards a future the companions hoped to reach.

23f85b20823797efebbdb41a.title: The First Tree's older knowledge
paragraphs: The ancient-tree illustration belongs to the search through druidical memory for Ashardalon and Dydd. The road to the Bastion had begun among such answers before dreams and the northern journey carried it far away.

109395cc0590b0a1fd928f96.title: Myra the Dragonhearted
paragraphs: Myra, a cleric of Tiamat and companion to the dragon Paraselson, belonged to the powers occupying the Bastion. Her portrait reveals another loyalty within its crystal halls without deciding how the company's final passage would meet it.

94f36f9823d642c7161cbab2.title: Baldur's Gate on the wider map
paragraphs: The coastal city map places the dream-bound investigation within a world still full of ordinary destinations. The Guild and Sleeper thread would make the company’s greatest uncertainty when it travelled, rather than merely where.

c4e1dad40836a9fdd7a04a8a.title: A face for the Sleeper's mystery
paragraphs: This portrait belongs beside the questions gathered around the Sleeper and the Guild of Sleep. The answers waiting in that thread would entangle an old captivity, a stolen stone, and the company's place in time.

f9f46dff5ad41aeb0eafe3d9.title: A warrior in the dream's company
paragraphs: The armoured figure evokes the dangerous people surrounding the Sleeper's long history. Eudostis's fate had shown how another person's choices could turn a captive into a familiar and stretch punishment across decades.

debdf292dda3fcdae533ec09.title: Beneath the Guild of Sleep
paragraphs: The chambers below the Guild opened the investigation into something deeper than a house of dreaming spellcasters. The company’s search there was bound to the Sleeper, the Time Stone, and the route into its own past.

8e474840988f512b427b00e5.title: A familiar face from the dream's circle
paragraphs: The red-clad figure belongs among the faces surrounding the campaign's dream-bound mysteries. In that chapter, appearances and familiar shapes could conceal a history far older than the company first understood.

e1c1d7b491dc0599e96e7cd9.title: A table worth coming back to
paragraphs: The crowded board recalls the food, rest, and hospitality that made Brindinford more than a place to fight. Returning to an earlier life also meant returning to small comforts the road had made precious.

ddefec5277fc387e37ffe8fe.title: A boat for an uncertain passage
paragraphs: The little craft recalls the vessel caught between the grotto's escape and Brindinford Falls. Its passengers would need the Deliverance's impossible rescue before the river carried them into another danger underground.

db6594860f313406813e9577.title: The other grotto
paragraphs: The Nightmare Grotto belonged to Crimson Crazuk and the danger of souls held in candles. Here Shrop snuffed the candle that released Pengu, setting in motion the loss of magic the company would face in Icewind Dale.

cb39bf6c8e6c36673d27aaf7.title: Crimson Crazuk's darkness
paragraphs: The bleeding skull gives the Nightmare Grotto the terrible face its name promises. Crazuk fell, but Pengu escaped when Shrop extinguished a candle, carrying the grotto’s consequences into the northern struggle against failing magic.

28f8265d4ce8bf36b1040dcb.title: A demand from the dragon
paragraphs: A red dragon’s address gives the collection another voice accustomed to making demands of mortals. It belongs among the company’s unfinished dealings with powerful beings as the road draws back towards the Bastion.

fca618798784bfbb7b6387b1.title: The Sleeper's first greeting
paragraphs: The filmed appearance of the Sleeper gives a face to the intelligence behind the company's next answers. Beyond the Guild's quiet rooms lay a conversation capable of changing the direction of the whole campaign.

c6dbbdd88f9b78243f07a02d.title: Demogorgon's divided purpose
paragraphs: The two-headed demon prince gives a body to the conflict between Aameul and Hethradiah. Their competing designs made the company’s struggle against Ashardalon useful to enemies with no interest in saving the unborn.

c10b8f3ca801c77d42e28a35.title: Eudostis remembers
paragraphs: Clouds and remembered images accompany Eudostis's place in the story of the stolen Time Stone. The ancestor's attempt to free the Sleeper had loosened another prison and ended in a long captivity of his own.

5193d3d3f751af4a8282b1d0.title: The Dreamer names Aameul
paragraphs: The Dreamer's explanation brings the company closer to one mind of Demogorgon and the design behind the Cathezar's hunt. Ashardalon's failing heart was also the prize in another monster's attempt to survive alone.

c11c652b45ec645483d65961.title: The Dreamer speaks of Ashardalon
paragraphs: The ancient red wyrm enters the Dreamer's account as a creature refusing the end Dydd's wound had promised him. The company’s separate adventures were carrying it towards the consequences of that refusal.

d29284a09681c4e52c91a182.title: The Dreamer points to the Bastion
paragraphs: The Bastion became a destination through the explanation of a place where souls gather before birth. Reaching it would eventually demand a fragment of the Soul Totem and a crossing into more life than a mortal body could bear.

1d1ceaba935fd54b924bf594.title: The Dreamer and the fallen god
paragraphs: Desayeus's prison entered the search because the fallen god still possessed part of the Soul Totem. The Dreamer's account turned a hidden divine punishment into a possible road towards Ashardalon.

49d391265bfec0f5b163b749.title: The Dreamer names Eco
paragraphs: Eco stood between the company and the prisoner whose fragment it needed. The Dreamer's explanation pointed towards a guardian whose body was the doorway and whose duty could not simply be dismissed.

2c86a2bcf466d530ded6deb1.title: The Dreamer explains the key
paragraphs: The Dreamer’s account turns to the broken pieces of Desayeus’s Soul Totem and the means of entering the Bastion. The company would eventually have to ask the fallen god for the fragment he still wore.

2925c60b471e38de1b5cd9fb.title: The ancestor in the Dreamer's tale
paragraphs: Eudostis's story joined the Time Stone to the Sleeper and the release of Crimson Crazuk. His long punishment as a parrot made the consequences of that theft intensely personal rather than merely ancient lore.

3a46ea47eb4968e5e64e530e.title: The Dreamer begins the tale
paragraphs: The Dreamer's opening places the company before answers reached through sleep rather than an ordinary road. The conversation would connect its present questions with people and decisions already lost in time.

7565bbfcfb95b724a4159698.title: The Church of Terry
paragraphs: The church's rooms give Terry's growing place in the world an expression beyond his own armour and weapons. When the company questioned Ernie, the fate of that church was among the things it wanted to hear about home.

2d3c68824292a1b91cfd1f74.title: Time catches the Dreamer
paragraphs: Waking brings the Dreamer a terrible change as age begins catching up with her. Her plea to repair the pod places the company beside the cost of returning from the Dream, long before its own displaced years were settled.

d51ed1a65d8ef5a821e9c09e.title: Dream a Little Dream
paragraphs: The radiant gathering recalls the moment the campaign turned back towards the company’s earlier lives. In Brindinford, the companions would become their eighth-level selves again and discover that the past could still demand action.

c961a67cf6488711eddb57d6.title: Shrop inside the dream
paragraphs: Shrop's place before the Dreamer makes the great detour a personal passage for one of the company. The road back through an earlier self still belonged to the same companions who would later return to a changed world.

a10fc9a217815a9a75220b98.title: The carnival barker
paragraphs: The bright barker adds a deliberately theatrical face to the campaign's world of strange invitations and stranger bargains. He belongs beside the dream-road's unsettling humour, where wonder could arrive carrying a sales pitch.

13a97c9f5a4025e947429080.title: Zemana
paragraphs: Zemana was an independent elven arcanist, driven by curiosity and a perfectionist’s love of enchantment. Her portrait adds another practitioner of magic to the dream-bound chapter, where knowledge and the freedom to choose one’s own path were already dangerous things.

085db9b34b7e8637007e298b.title: The Time Stone's clockwork echo
paragraphs: The intricate dial gives the dream detour's stolen stone an image of time held within a small object. Eudostis's attempt to use that power set consequences moving far beyond the rescue he intended.

fd2d8f2975a750d211f70411.title: A bed for travelling out of time
paragraphs: This improbable little bed belongs to the campaign's imagery of sleep, dreams, and movement through time. The company’s earlier lives in Brindinford turned those ideas into a journey it would have to find its way back from.

a082c398ed94f2cc921f44e3.title: Water flowing through the air
paragraphs: The impossible stream recalls White Plume Mountain's delight in making ordinary movement unreliable. Keraptis's challenge turned the way across a room into a problem almost as dangerous as what waited at its end.

0c90e3b744f49d27d90247c4.title: The crab beyond the bubble
paragraphs: The armoured crab gives a face to the boiling danger guarding Wave's route. Beneath White Plume, a legendary weapon could wait behind a creature quite prepared to make the approach memorable.

9853054ddd4a7b533a148120.title: The living town beyond the dream
paragraphs: The broad townscape recalls Brindinford as a lived-in place before the later ruin. In the Sleeper's detour, the company could walk its earlier streets while the future it hoped to return to remained uncertain.

f4bc05b2ea78c215dba00617.title: The Narrator's grin
paragraphs: The die-marked skull belongs to the voice keeping the company's many roads in view. Its smile is fitting for a tale whose final answers still wait where Ashardalon feeds upon the unborn.

9cbc94ecf76ec9e4a142802e.title: Every question led towards the Bastion
paragraphs: The gathered goals reveal the connections behind the company's long, interrupted investigation. Thunder's ancestry and the world's missing souls kept pointing back towards a reckoning the detours could delay but not erase.

19efa29372286cde93e35d24.title: The Dreamer's displeasure
paragraphs: The Dreamer's appearance against the ice places a familiar intelligence beside the northern journey. The company’s bargain with dreams had not vanished simply because it had found its way into another adventure.

fc5399725f2ef771d336192a.title: A face worn by the long road
paragraphs: The weathered figure evokes the people and possibilities surrounding the company’s displaced years. Returning from the dream would leave the companions to recognise a world that had continued without them.

92db6b1630e54173df2f1e5a.title: Captain Timothy Pepper
paragraphs: Pepper commanded the Deliverance when its strange voyage crossed the paths of the two companies. His ship's arrival beside the falling boat exchanged Brindinford Falls for a desperate return to the underground river.

91152e48419431995926abe0.title: The dire weasel
paragraphs: The enlarged weasel brings the campaign's smallest sort of scout into a much more formidable shape. It belongs beside the familiar-led searches through places where sending something ahead could keep the whole company alive.

30b86f51278b96993fba03f9.title: A passage through the stars
paragraphs: The distant light evokes the crossings between worlds that carried the company towards the Bastion. The Soul Totem fragment would eventually guide four mortals into a realm where the glow itself could be deadly.

504fb883f1a83b4c6c58b056.title: A rod for a quiet hour
paragraphs: The elaborate fishing rod recalls that an adventurer's possessions need not all be meant for combat. Brindinford's simpler days could hold a little leisure beside the investments and preparations laid against an uncertain future.

335fec1d1fd8bbba8c82a782.title: A hunger from stranger depths
paragraphs: The pale, open-mouthed horror evokes the life waiting beyond the campaign's familiar paths. It belongs beside the aboleth expedition, where the danger could reach into a victim as well as strike from the dark.

9b5b7d88e158499cb78621e5.title: Neverwinter on the road north
paragraphs: The city map places the hunt for Keraptis within the wider coast before the company's northern struggles. Rumours about the stolen weapons gave familiar streets a place in a pursuit that would lead towards the ice.

f471e2eb538751c5f104bafd.title: Tentacles beyond the water
paragraphs: The coiling aquatic creature gives the underwater adventure another image of danger beyond a traveller's reach. Below the surface, the company faced an enemy whose influence did not end where its body stopped.

5188d7a7c3631240e46e9877.title: A camp before the next crossing
paragraphs: The sheltered enclosure recalls the temporary homes that stood between the company's longer journeys. The northern road gave such pauses a particular value when travel, altered behaviour, and uncertain obligations were already wearing at the companions.

2405e32de11e063e6c375617.title: The Bank of Frobozz
paragraphs: The bank gives the company's plans for its treasure an address inside the time-travel story. Investing there meant trusting that something laid aside in Brindinford could still have a place in the future.

92c6408d4077fda950990c49.title: Luskan by its bridges
paragraphs: Luskan's river and crowded approaches belong to the coastal world around the pursuit of the legendary weapons. The Arcane Brotherhood's interests would follow that road towards the northern spire and its corrupted inhabitants.

a887bd5e1e803472ec1d4ff9.title: The City of Pirates
paragraphs: The harbour and towers give Luskan a broader face beyond lines on a map. The company's weapons hunt moved through a world where sailors, wizards, and thieves could all have reasons to care about the same rumour.

172be4b9372b8bfbc39418fb.title: A place for Grim to call home
paragraphs: Grim's home gives the restless scholar a setting beyond the next cavern or battlefield. It belongs beside the company's return to Brindinford's earlier days, when possessions and investments could still suggest a settled future.

c2e9b7512666f71c29158d3e.title: Ashardalon
paragraphs: The ancient red dragon had survived Dydd's destruction of his heart by binding Ammet within himself. At the Bastion, his dependence on unborn souls turned that refusal to die into a disaster reaching across the world.

56c1be328128c97083ac9ff6.title: Po of the Bastion
paragraphs: Po met the company among the defenders inside the crystalline fortress. His fall came during the hard passage through the dragonspawn and Grisly's ambush on the way towards Ashardalon.

f207733f09579b3a35d1b311.title: The dragon's terrible presence
paragraphs: This dramatic vision gives Ashardalon the scale and menace carried by his name throughout the campaign. It stands at the edge of the final reckoning, leaving the dragon's actual fate to the company’s confrontation.

deeca74dee22cf2e62e16f47.title: Oakhurst, where people waited
paragraphs: The village map returns the great campaign to the small settlement that first needed news of missing adventurers. Coming back from the Citadel meant answering the Hucreles and warning people who would never descend into the ruin themselves.

09923c7d04eabbdc4d3904e4.title: The Gulthias Tree
paragraphs: The sinister tree connected Belak's strange harvest to a vampire's older legacy. Beneath Oakhurst, its roots planted the first great shadow of the story that would eventually lead back to Gulthias and Ashardalon.

3225e134fa7549ea8e690341.title: A flashback upon the water
paragraphs: The film’s backward glance returns to a boat and the companions’ earlier travels. The river roads around Brindinford belonged to the same history that later journeys would keep finding reasons to revisit.

af177eb6b6b06f2f0ec7050b.title: A stop in the wooded dark
paragraphs: The forested battlefield recalls the danger surrounding the company's investigation beyond Ossington. The journey towards answers could be interrupted by an ambush long before anyone reached the next welcoming door.

f6517e6924d320739d97daeb.title: Glitterhame in another light
paragraphs: This misty cavern scene recalls the uncanny beauty beneath Khundrukar. Among that water and growth, the company had to keep distinguishing an inviting light from a reason to take greater care.

788a4009c52a23af0bf8322a.title: The warlord's wooded ground
paragraphs: The woodland clearing belongs beside the ancient warrior's chapter around Ossington. The company’s willingness to seek Saithnar's answers brought the region's older battles into its present investigation.

871321f46cddf4cc50c12c0b.title: The catacombs below Nightfang
paragraphs: The long passages beneath the tower held more than Gulthias's sleeping dead. Girallons, servitors, and Thiff's resistance made the buried halls another front in the vampire's struggle to control his domain.

f63d95454ef08d07878ffb9b.title: The bargain, another telling
paragraphs: This longer telling returns to the forest meeting and the elemental guardian on the road into Nightfang. It preserves the same threshold of the adventure from another angle, where a conversation could decide who became the master of a passage.

e036b5ac103d62dfc9377650.title: Gulthias
paragraphs: The vampire at Nightfang carried a history the company had already brushed against beneath the Sunless Citadel. His undead cult kept Ashardalon's return alive as an ambition, joining the first adventure's roots to the tower's dead heart.

3598b3eb94c69b32ef5e8812.title: Fire on the old road
paragraphs: The burning figure gives the Ossington chapter an image of dread and accusation. It belongs beside an investigation whose ambush and blazing tower left the company with very practical reasons to escape.

ded63af023f2e169941fcab0.title: An unwelcome reputation
paragraphs: Shrop's face upon a wanted notice turns the company's growing reputation into a joke with an edge. Brindinford had shown how quickly public honours could be followed by public orders against the people who had earned them.

7908baaf4c6e2cf4ba9f99ff.title: Brindinford's docks
paragraphs: The waterfront placed the town upon the river roads linking the company's early adventures. These were the living approaches to a place that would later be remembered through ruined streets and impossible voyages.

37214aa11f3b1055401cab70.title: Almut Shield-Breaker
paragraphs: Almut's dwarven portrait belongs beside the forge chapter's world of craft, strength, and stubborn histories. Such faces give the search for Durgeddin's work a people as well as a legendary name.

b327f5b9aed79c5a2a04ec08.title: The wider Faerûn
paragraphs: The continental map measures how far the company's concerns had travelled from its first ruined fortress. Even this broad country would eventually prove too small a frame for journeys reaching Acheron and the Bastion.

2f45279208fff79f367c6f54.title: Downriver between adventures
paragraphs: Brindinford, Blasingdell, and the river route join the early chapters into a continuous journey. The company carried the consequences of one adventure along the same waterways that led towards the next.

ba2fe62daac1f1410b5a0001.title: Thunder before another disguise
paragraphs: The brooding portrait recalls the companion whose quick hands concealed a much more private trouble. Thunder's decision to share his lycanthropy helped make the early company a circle of trust as well as a useful fighting force.

ec5e626aa61654f84d1c8d33.title: Grim, ready with an answer
paragraphs: The gnome with fire in hand gives the company's scholar an appropriately dangerous introduction. Finding Grim in the Citadel added curiosity, a familiar's scouting, and a voice for restraint to the party's first expedition.

ec1f56c343ece78d692d7368.title: A captain's imposing figure
paragraphs: The grand, bearded traveller evokes the larger-than-life company surrounding the campaign's voyages. The Deliverance's chapter would show that the character of a passage could depend very much on the people offering it.

268911643d62d2a7f94e99ab.title: Under canvas for the night
paragraphs: The furnished tent recalls the temporary shelters that made a traveller's life possible between discoveries. During the return to earlier Brindinford, such small provisions belonged beside plans for a future that might not arrive as expected.

ec700f7cca86cb654782da8b.title: Thomo
paragraphs: Thomo's portrait adds another local face to the company’s crowded world of towns and travellers. Brindinford's chapter mattered because the place held people as well as the conspiracy threatening them.

595287b844ea1764d8b93027.title: The Bear Pit poster
paragraphs: The poster advertises spectacle beneath the Stolen Sons' name, mixing entertainment with a familiar organisation's reach. It belongs beside the company's arrival at a fair where public amusements and private interests occupied the same streets.

ef58d8ad7a9cc62e11634415.title: Paths through a green cavern
paragraphs: The wooded pools and branching paths evoke the unexpected life the company found below the surface. Deep Horizon made exploration a matter of entering inhabited worlds rather than simply passing through empty darkness.

729b1eaf97713bff190b0f1e.title: A shadow from the deeper hunt
paragraphs: The winged, tentacled creature gives the underground struggle another unsettling silhouette. The company's descent was drawing it towards enemies whose shapes and purposes were increasingly distant from the ordinary road.

9f0a771b2f3804c9bd4087af.title: Cloak and Dagger
paragraphs: The playful disguises turn two familiar campaign faces into a miniature conspiracy of their own. They fit a chapter where investigation, concealed identities, and a sense of humour could all be useful equipment.

07b6c5e3c9ceef1c330daf91.title: Grimble's rooms
paragraphs: The furnished home gives Grim's life a little space for books, belongings, and a table beyond the next expedition. Returning to the company's earlier days also meant returning to the possibility of a home worth preparing for.

c7e52735ffcc06481d5f2910.title: The smugglers' cove
paragraphs: Boats concealed beneath the stone recall the waterways and secret trade joining the deep adventure to Brindinford. The company’s discoveries beneath the surface were part of the same world as the troubles waiting at home.

5bdfeb48b7550a7939617043.title: The fishing vendor
paragraphs: The vendor's portrait belongs to the quieter business of the company's travels: finding something useful for an hour without a battle. Brindinford's earlier streets offered room for such purchases beside the much weightier investments.

561357bf0a3c466e8a465d26.title: The Cuckoo's face
paragraphs: The Cuckoo's name returns in the demon guard encountered as the company forced its way deeper into the Bastion. This unassuming portrait gives that ominous title a surprisingly ordinary face.

f03c7b0ea064c1f34e0f642b.title: Under the town's streets
paragraphs: The sewer's bends recall the concealed routes beneath a town otherwise busy with a fair. Brindinford's investigation required the company to look below the life its rulers were willing to show in public.

95bc65c351ca848dd6460954.title: The Outlands and the gates beyond
