paragraphs: The great ring of planar destinations places Rigus within a much larger geography. Following the road to Acheron meant learning that a town could stand at the edge of an entirely different kind of world.

98f2647719524525fff2364c.title: The old pond from above
paragraphs: The small pond is one more ordinary corner preserved from the campaign's world of towns and journeys. Such places give the later adventures scale by recalling how modest a familiar landmark could once seem.

12d0fa739b58d859556e5b07.title: Brindinford's barracks
paragraphs: The barracks became hard-won ground when the two companies fought through the ant-held Sunken City. A building once tied to the town guard now offered a position from which exhausted survivors could consider the next advance.

c70af5773352df7a5fbd1dd2.title: The bell tower in the town's memory
paragraphs: The old tower plan returns one of Brindinford's familiar landmarks to view. In the buried city, a hidden system of resonance and control had given the colony's deeper stronghold a much darker connection to the bell tower.

6fc1acd0a39beb0f77654920.title: The detective and the kraken
paragraphs: An enormous tentacled monster towers over the purple-coated detective in this theatrical encounter. The scene gives Brindinford’s stranger side an extravagant image, fitting a chapter where ordinary streets concealed much less ordinary horrors.

51c3360536b2ed1e5dc855a3.title: At Eastgate's end
paragraphs: The gathered figures recall the people guarding the approaches to Brindinford. The town's gates became part of the crisis when the Baron's proclamation turned movement, weapons, and protection into instruments of control.

d7445c211f0b05bac41536d8.title: Acheron's impossible ground
paragraphs: Great cubes drifted through a plane shaped by endless war, making the ground itself a moving threat. Team Biscuit's route from Rigus to the Iron Fortress carried it into this vast and hostile landscape.

4847851838a9af12e308c28d.title: Shoomma
paragraphs: Shoomma's portrait gives the company's smithy investment a familiar face. Alongside Horken, the smith represented a practical future the companions hoped their treasure might help build across the uncertain years.

094db84d721bd6ee6015cad9.title: Durgeddin the Black
paragraphs: The legendary smith's work drew the company towards Khundrukar after its first adventure. The ruined forge made his name something it could explore, recover, and carry into Terry's growing connection with dwarven craft.

259eab3470d80228b0881f23.title: Terry, ready to stand in front
paragraphs: The armoured dwarf recalls the companion who brought healing, stubborn strength, and a useful supply of chalk to the early company. The Forge gave that practical devotion another mountain's worth of trouble to work through.

8cf1d2aa5498f8d6b29c6ac7.title: The battle for Brindinford
paragraphs: The marked town map returns the collection to the struggle for the company's home front. Adventures on other planes did not prevent Brindinford from becoming a battlefield in a history the companions would later have to understand.

9032b1bf7f56735f3e185656.title: Meepo of the Citadel
paragraphs: Meepo belongs to the kobold side of the buried fortress and its troubles surrounding Calcryx. His small face recalls the first adventure's factions, when a conversation could be as valuable as choosing whom to fight.

72a78c71a9443f37358f2ce0.title: Show me a king
paragraphs: The red dragon demands an accounting from travellers who disappeared from its reach and questions the part played by wizards. Its address recalls the company’s complicated dealings with beings accustomed to treating other lives as matters for their own authority.

eb9baf91ccb433a10edad20b.title: A priest of Pelor
paragraphs: The priest's portrait recalls the faith and people placed under threat in Brindinford. The company’s defence of the temple would give that struggle a personal cost when Shatterspike became part of its sacrifice.

4b3b5f1e123c818df00f01e9.title: The quiet white cloak
paragraphs: The familiar white-cloaked figure recalls Brother Ernie and the questions surrounding his impossible return. The company would recognise the smile and gestures even when the journey behind them remained difficult to explain.

Hindsight: his recovery stopped short of Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor because Xanthar had taken them back to White Plume Mountain. Blackrazor had already been sacrificed; the three survivors carry their grievance beneath the mountain.

7f0785a735acb7da0bcccf5c.title: Shrop's new dream, first passage
paragraphs: The dream gathers Shrop and his companions before another opening in the life they thought they knew. It belongs beside the return to their earlier selves, when the campaign could make an old road dangerous all over again.

1f5f1edbfbe56925b6ac7672.title: Shrop's new dream, the crossing
paragraphs: The burst of radiance carries the dream from a conversation towards a passage. For the company, returning to an earlier Brindinford would be an adventure with consequences reaching twenty years beyond its original time.

40f1dbcd158ebe6cc33745b9.title: Gramps to the rescue
paragraphs: The elder's arrival among the dream figures brings Grim's family thread back into view. Eudostis's history made ancestry part of the mystery around the Sleeper, rather than merely a name behind a companion's own.

9f3877ab6480f2ac2aacf29e.title: Gathered in the chamber
paragraphs: The long table and assembled figures give this scene the weight of an audience rather than a roadside meeting. It belongs beside the questions surrounding Terry's changed voice and the divine obligations pressing upon the northern journey.

e4cdb9ae5e9fe6297199e8fb.title: The chamber's answer
paragraphs: The gathering continues around Terry and the companions, with familiar faces drawn into a solemn room. The scene recalls how the campaign's divine questions could arrive through a conversation before they demanded another journey.

cdcc6c696090285ff8be2af5.title: The next word in the chamber
paragraphs: The continuing chamber scene keeps the companions together before the figures surrounding their next questions. It belongs beside the northern chapter's concern with Terry, his altered behaviour, and the powers taking an interest in him.

cbf240c67b9e3173b52e2a0d.title: The familiar's small face
paragraphs: The little weasel recalls the scouting that became part of Grim's place in the company. A creature small enough to slip ahead could make the next discovery less painful for everyone following it.

828542a64ccfdbefbe44299c.title: Ernie's familiar gesture
paragraphs: The brief appearance of the white-cloaked friend preserves the company’s old acquaintance in motion. Ernie's later reunion would depend on the same recognisable face and expressive silence after an absence they had feared was permanent.

Ernie returned most of the lost equipment. Hindsight reveals why the remaining three epic weapons were beyond that reunion: Xanthar had returned them to the mountain he now ruled, where their hatred for the Brotherhood endured.

2a81cd78d1d68ef7cbfed6b4.title: Radiance in the sanctuary
paragraphs: The holy signs and gathering light recall the campaign's long traffic with divine messages and the familiar white cloak. The questions the company later brought to Ernie were rooted in years of faith, danger, and unexplained departures.

845114928bcefca70bcdce15.title: Words beside the fountain
paragraphs: The pool and the figures around it give this remembered scene the quiet shape of a place where answers might emerge. It belongs beside the dream-bound investigation, where the next conversation could matter as much as the next battle.

9a8fe8b467539b524c1ecc91.title: Thunder's training day
paragraphs: The training film offers a smaller, more personal view of the quick hands and quick feet the company relied upon. It sits beside the return to the companions' earlier selves, recalling that such confidence had a history of its own.

038b5acc03e9499080155f61.title: The northern trouble begins
paragraphs: The filmed opening returns to the frozen town and the forces gathering around it. It belongs beside the raid on Easthaven, where the company’s northern work became a defence of streets and lives already under pressure from the endless winter.

2ec6e96ddd5eafb1d5bc635f.title: The northern road remembered
paragraphs: The refresher returns the company to the icy ground and gathered figures of its northern battles. It recalls how the struggle around Easthaven connected the fate of a town to the larger dangers moving through the Dale.

3f7e1af6a0a41af2fe48f95f.title: Double my number
paragraphs: Terry's vacant stare and repeated words give the change in his behaviour a particularly unsettling form. The northern journey began with a companion whose voice could no longer be taken as a simple account of what he intended.

ab0409c0d03e052826b3cdc7.title: Across the broken ice
paragraphs: The icy setting returns the collection to the northern chapter and its uncanny dangers. Beside Pengu's transformations, even a strange little interruption could belong to a landscape that had ceased to feel entirely trustworthy.

52c3702ae60f0227d5fc7030.title: Pelor's holy blade
paragraphs: The radiant sword gives the company's relationship with Pelor a visible expression of hope and power. It belongs beside the vision on the ice, where the long weapons story met the campaign's divine concerns again.

328df1db1f56173759de412b.title: Pengu's grand promise
paragraphs: This telling gives Pengu's icy address another place in the collection. Its promise of power stands beside the company’s confrontation and the ominous egg that kept the enemy's future unresolved.

16d24d9bcf63aa36a4269793.title: Divine dreams
paragraphs: The dream film belongs beside the visions that interrupted the company's northern road. Gods, great weapons, and unanswered obligations could make sleep another place where the companions' next direction was contested.

d0a2c035724ddb3437495576.title: A dance at the portal
paragraphs: The dancing figure brings a delightfully undignified answer to the problem of a magical threshold. It recalls the campaign's willingness to place absurdity beside the very serious business of finding a way onward between worlds.

2b54238995719e78071af082.title: Pelor's temple, room by room
paragraphs: The temple plan gives the company's defence of the holy place a set of rooms and approaches. Behind the map lay priests, refugees, and a town learning how little protection its rulers intended to offer them.

b5df35c40648b1b6ebd10829.title: Shrop's signature fishing rod
paragraphs: The crafted rod gives Shrop a possession whose purpose begins with patience rather than breaking a door. It belongs beside the quieter promise of Brindinford's earlier days, when treasure could become something meant for enjoyment as well as survival.

6e14001db27c0ffd66491dc6.title: Together in the great hall
paragraphs: The four familiar figures bring the campaign's many roads back to the company itself. Whatever powers had designed the journey, Shrop, Grim, Terry, and Thunder were the ones who had kept walking it together.

552b867b481e9a6e65697981.title: A wave from the company
paragraphs: The companions' quiet farewell gathers the campaign into a gesture more personal than a victory speech. It celebrates the people who made the journey without deciding what the final battle will take from them or leave behind.

d271ffaff4c6be084f5dbbdf.title: The warrior and the fortress
paragraphs: The spirit-haunted warrior gives the fortress chapter an image of strength carrying more than its own weight. It echoes a struggle in which the imprisoned dead and the ambitions of the living had become bound to the same weapon.

9b053ed4eab8d2eddbd772c2.title: Grim's chain lightning
paragraphs: The gnome's branching magic gives a dramatic form to one of Grim's decisive answers at the Bastion's approach. In the recorded fighting, his lightning struck among the retriever and the fiends while the company forced its way towards the gate.

e75936ecc3044ec2e4573113.title: The crossing at the falls
paragraphs: A small boat passes before the waterfall, with a cave mouth glowing in the cliffside.
